rows.grounds: imperative expressing a prayer or wish
subject invoked as the granting agent
emphatic particle restricting efficacy to devotion
genitive pronoun referring to the addressed deity

items.question: What beneficial outcome is sought through purifying devotion directed toward the addressed deity?
premises: The practitioner requests welfare for themselves.
Purifying devotion directed toward the deity is invoked as the agent.
This devotion alone is emphasized as effective.
items.inference: Purifying devotion to the addressed deity alone is sufficient to bestow welfare on the practitioner.
uncertainties: The referent of 'te' is inferred from the preceding verses to be the invoked mantra-deity.
items.plain_english: May your purifying devotion alone grant me welfare.
